text:
Elaine H: Quick sync — AstraNova deep-dive. We did the customer interview this morning and they agreed to do a short case and join a webinar. Need: quote sign-off, benchmark narrative for the launch post, and legal OK on the claim language. Interview recording and transcript in the share.
Devon R: Draft benchmark summary pulled from last week's load test.
Devon R: Results: 25–32% per-token cost reduction when using prefix caching + dynamic batching on typical AstraNova workloads. p95 latency unchanged (~120ms). Draft claim: `up to 30% lower inference cost`.
James K: Suggest we soften: "typical workloads saw ~25–30% savings" — avoids absolute-sounding "up to" framing for broader marketing.
Maria S: AstraNova provided this quote in the interview: "Redwood cut our inference cost by roughly a third while keeping response times steady — gave us breathing room on cloud spend." They emailed OK to use the paraphrase but want to review final wording.
Amanda L: Webinar ask: can we slot them for the April 12 customer panel? Would want a 20m slot + 10m Q&A. Also need a short 2-slide case summary for the moderator. I'll coordinate logistics with events.
Elaine H: Timeline ask: marketing needs final quote and benchmark language by EOD Tuesday to hit our April 18 launch window. Can legal confirm?
Jules (Legal): Hi — thanks. Two quick items:
- Please attach the raw benchmark results and the test methodology. We need to confirm reproducibility and that numbers aren't cherry-picked.
- For the customer quote: we need a signed permission email from AstraNova with the exact quote text they approve. No implied attribution until signed.
Devon R: Pushed raw CSV + run commands to the doc: `s3://redwood/internal/bench/astra/2024-03-18/results.csv` and run command we used: 
```
./run_bench --model redwood-medium-quant --batch 8 --seq 512 --cache-prefix --samples 10000
```
Measurement script in repo: `bench/inference/measure_cost.py` (commit 4f2a9c).
Jules (Legal): Good. Also please replace any claim that reads as a guarantee ("cut costs by a third") with a phrasing that attributes to the customer's statement or to the specific benchmark. e.g., "AstraNova reported ~33% cost reduction in our internal benchmark" or "Internal benchmarks show typical 25–30% savings for AstraNova-like workloads." We also need the comparison baseline spelled out (what "previous setup" means).
Maria S: I'll ask AstraNova to sign the quote and confirm exact wording today. They said they'd be quick about it.
Amanda L: For the webinar deck: putting together two slide options — story-first (customer challenges -> win) and data-first (benchmark graphs -> customer quote). Which do we want for the panel? Thoughts?
James K: Data-first for the tech audience, story-first for broader product folks. If the panel is mixed, do a hybrid: 1 slide challenge, 1 slide small graph + quote.
Elaine H: Perfect. Action list:
- Maria: get signed quote text from AstraNova (due EOD Tue)
- Devon: drop the benchmark CSV + short methodology blurb into the doc and add a 1-paragraph "how we measured" for legal (due Mon)
- Jules: confirm whether the proposed phrasing is acceptable once we have methodology and signed quote
- Amanda: draft hybrid 2-slide deck and share for review (due Wed)
deploy-bot: Reminder: marketing-calendar event created: April 18 launch draft. Organizer: Amanda L.
Devon R: Noted — I'll add a short appendix with the test seeds and traffic mix we used (50/50 short/long prompts).
Jules (Legal): Thanks all. If Maria can get an explicit "I approve the quote below" email from AstraNova with the exact text, legal can fast-track sign-off. Otherwise expect 48hrs.
Maria S: On it. Ping me if you need direct intro to their comms lead.
Elaine H: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the launch copy draft once we lock the wording. :thumbsup:
